artifact.netlist:
* Remote dual-rail power budget design
* 48V source feeds remote board via sense + wire resistance
V1 vin 0 DC 48
Rsense vin top 0.5
Rwire top remote 3
* Dropper resistors sized so V12=12V, V5=5V exactly under given loads
* I12 = V12/Rl12 = 12/60 = 0.2A, I5 = V5/Rl5 = 5/50 = 0.1A
* Total supply current = I12+I5+Iaux = 0.2+0.1+0.05 = 0.35A (<=0.4A)
* Vremote = 48 - 0.35*(0.5+3) = 46.775V
* Rd12 = (Vremote-12)/0.2 = 173.875 ohm
* Rd5  = (Vremote-5)/0.1  = 417.75 ohm
Rd12 remote v12 173.875
Rd5 remote v5 417.75
Rl12 v12 0 60
Rl5 v5 0 50
Iaux remote 0 DC 50m
.op
.end
